visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with green-dyed hair tied in a ponytail and wearing a black sleeveless top stands in a brightly lit indoor room. Behind her is a light blue wall adorned with a gold-framed picture. She speaks energetically toward the camera, using expressive facial expressions and hand gestures to introduce the topic. (2) She holds up a pink plastic package labeled in Japanese with an illustration of a gorilla squeezing a calf. She points to the package details while continuing her energetic narration. The lighting is consistent, casting a bright, even glow across her face and the product. (3) She transitions to a black box with an 'angry' red gorilla illustration. She demonstrates the perceived intensity of this version by tensing her hands and mimicking a squeezing motion. A ring light is visible in the background, reflecting off the picture frame. (4) She introduces a third box featuring a gold-haired 'Super Saiyan' gorilla character. Her eyes widen and her mouth opens in a surprised expression as she points to the intense imagery on the packaging, indicating a 'boss level' product. (5) The camera cuts to her legs as she wraps the pink massager around her calf while sitting on a patterned sofa. She presses the control buttons on the device. Her facial reaction is neutral, suggesting the massage intensity is relatively low or mild. (6) She wraps the black 'angry' massager around her leg and activates it. As the intensity increases, she leans back, her face showing signs of pressure and slight discomfort, though she continues to speak to the viewer throughout the test. (7) She tests the 'Super Saiyan' version, and her reaction is immediate and extreme. Her mouth opens wide in a silent scream of pain, and she frantically gestures with her hands as the device compresses her leg. The background remains the same living room setting. (8) A man in a grey t-shirt and blue shorts is shown sitting on the sofa, testing the high-intensity massager. He appears noticeably calmer than the woman, looking down at the device while she films his reaction from a slightly higher angle. (9) A woman with bright orange hair and a tan top is then shown testing the pink massager. She begins to laugh hysterically and winces in pain as the intensity builds, eventually leaning her head back against the sofa in an exaggerated reaction of suffering. (10) The main green-haired woman returns to the eye-level framing, holding all three products and summarizing her findings. She points at each one to provide recommendations for different user types before holding the pink package close to the camera for a giveaway announcement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a humorous yet informative review of three different DOSHISHA leg massagers from Japan. By testing the devices on herself and two guests, the creator compares the intensity levels—from 'basic' to 'Super Saiyan'—to guide viewers on which version suits their physical activity levels, while also driving engagement through a giveaway.
